statement:
by
  classical
  exact let J := fun a b m : ℕ => ((Finset.Icc a b).filter (fun e => Nat.Prime (m-2^e))).card; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ T, let L := Nat.log 2 X / 2; c*(X:ℝ) ≤ (((Finset.Ico X (2*X)).filter (fun m => Odd m ∧ 0<J 1 (L/2) m ∧ 0<J (L/2+1) L m)).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 低指数带和高指数带各有一个表示的不同奇目标占正比例。
plain_statement.en: A positive proportion of distinct odd targets meet both separated exponent bands.

brief.zh: 保留既有 cross-band-overlap 题的两个指数范围，把加权混合质量提升为不同目标数。该计数下界推出旧的质量下界；反过来必须排除少数高重数点支配均值。可先控制乘积的截断尾部，再用二阶矩。
brief.en: Keep the bands of the existing cross-band overlap task, counting each target only once. This implies its weighted lower bound. Control concentration of the product on high-multiplicity targets to go in the stronger direction.
